items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: The interviewer asks if 'guys must have come to you and said, Hey, Kaz, can you loan me 50 bucks?' and the interviewee confirms 'Yeah, I did a lot of that.'

ctx.x: And so that's what I was doing. But I still was maintaining the studio. You know, I got together a little junk equipment. And I had people over there running it. And that I was paying while I was doing this other thing to get back. And then I eventually got back, of course. I'd like to sometimes, off the tape, tell you about a couple of things that happened in that little transition. That'll give you insight into a couple of people in the city that you might serve you well.

Do you want to do it on the tape? No. No, no. It's too personal. Stop the tape. Okay. Okay. Well, we're back on. Well, I think some of the stuff you said, I think we could... I'd rather not. No, no, no, no. Let me specifically ask a question. All right. Let me just ask a specific question. And again, you being in the cat bird seat, so to speak, guys must have come to you and said, Hey, Kaz, can you loan me 50 bucks? Can you loan me 100 bucks till... Yeah, I did a lot of that. I got the rents due. I did a lot of…
Personally, you mean? Yes. I know one guy in this town, still playing, who called me from Baltimore. The show went bust. And I need money to get home.
